releases.title: Easy Classics
releases.description:
"...What if cultivated musicians could deal with the classical repertoire as a Dj or an electronic producer would use any music artwork or sample or music library, live or in the studio practices: interpreting this huge collection of music expressions as a starting and solid reference for a new and abstract concert ritual, synchronically multilayered, diachronically wide and inclusive, reopenable as only a radical sampling practice could allow postmodern musicians to be, with their synthetic idiosyncrasies (simplifications...ripen postmodernity) (...).
I can imagine Glen Gould accepting the challenge: conducting in real time a recorded piece, altering its musical fundamentals, without losing the linear evolution, or just preserving the strong memory of the reference, altering its time consistency and its original narrative or ritual function (...). 
An open door for future integral and extensive meta-players, ultra-level djs (...)".

Lorenzo Brusci, December 2005
